## Summary

Describe the change and the learning problem it solves.

## Scope

- [ ] Content or explanation
- [ ] Notebook or code
- [ ] Exercise or project
- [ ] Tooling or repository maintenance
- [ ] Bug fix

## Validation

- [ ] Notebooks run from a clean kernel, top to bottom.
- [ ] Python checks pass with `python -m pytest` and `python -m ruff check .`.
- [ ] Local links resolve.
- [ ] No datasets larger than 50 MB, model weights, secrets, or personal data are included.
- [ ] The change is written in English.
- [ ] The master roadmap is updated if progress or dates changed.

## Related Issues

Link related issues and explain any follow-up work.
